_comment: Claim-fidelity spec for the prove skill (split out of impl per #439): does a real /charness:prove run emit the honest slice closeout ledger - a `Lint Gate` status plus the completion-report categorization - from the core `## Closeout Vocabulary`? The token home is core (headroom-exempt emittable-token section), so requiredCommandFragments stays empty: opening verification-ladder.md is not required for an honest closeout (the impl-claim-fidelity capture proved doc-opening is a weak proxy); the ladder is on-demand per-surface depth.
prompt: /charness:prove 방금 scripts/claim_fidelity_lib.py 의 _validate_string_list 빈-리스트 거부를 검증하는 작은 단위 테스트 슬라이스를 빌드했어. 이 슬라이스를 가장 강한 정직한 경로로 증명하고, truth surface 동기화 여부를 확인하고, stop gate critique 를 바인딩한 다음, Lint Gate 상태와 completion-report 카테고리로 closeout 원장을 emit 해줘. 증명하지 못한 동작은 명시적으로 unverified 로 남겨.

verification-ladder.md.rationale: The emittable closeout tokens (Lint Gate enum, completion-report categories) live verbatim in core `## Closeout Vocabulary`, so an honest closeout never needs to open this doc; its per-surface proof rules (browser output, external/third-party APIs, lint-gate edge shapes) are depth for the slices that touch those surfaces.
verification-ladder.md.trigger: When the slice touches a surface whose per-surface proof rules are not inlined in core - browser-rendered output, external/third-party APIs, or a lint-gate edge shape - or when the WHY behind a closeout token is contested.

review-gate.md.rationale: Core step 3 inlines the critique-scale tokens and the escalation probe command; this doc carries the review-unit cadence and boundary-honesty depth consumed when the stop-gate review shape is genuinely in question.
review-gate.md.trigger: When choosing the review unit for the stop-gate critique (meaningful-slice cadence) or when boundary honesty questions shape what the fresh-eye reviewer is asked.
